result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I did not add a test for the cancelled case, and the one run I did used a test pattern that may not match any test class.

The fix is one added condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, in the count subquery of `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java` (around line 6517). It matches how the per-quarter and per-weekday purchase-order reports already filter.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0. The ordering is unchanged: highest count first, then name, then id.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='SalesRepPurchaseOrderCount*'`. It finished with no output and no failures, but I didn't confirm that any test class matched that pattern. I also didn't run your Anna/Bob example.
